# NanoClaw REPL

Curated by Skill Harbor: operate and extend NanoClaw, ECC's zero-dependency session-aware REPL, when running or extending `scripts/claw.js`, or when resuming, branching, compacting, searching or exporting a session. Sessions are persistent and markdown-backed (markdown as the database), with slash commands for model switching (`/model`), dynamic skill loading (`/load`), session branching (`/branch`), cross-session search (`/search`), history compaction (`/compact`), export to md, json or txt (`/export`), and session metrics (`/metrics`). Operating guidance: keep sessions task-focused, branch before high-risk changes, compact after major milestones, export before sharing or archival. Extension rules: keep zero external runtime dependencies, preserve markdown-as-database compatibility, keep command handlers deterministic and local. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: small reference skill for an experimental surface; if you extend the REPL, the zero-dependency rule is the whole point, adding npm packages breaks the contract. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
